name: core-runtime-finalizer-context-tail-api67
notes: Attached-finalizer context is executed in a deterministic local Queueable drain; no unsupported no-arg FinalizerContextImpl, zero hosted Salesforce parity, and no worker lifecycle claim.
salesforceExclusionReason: Attached local finalizer execution has zero hosted Salesforce parity and is not a worker lifecycle oracle.

source.content: public class FinalizerContextTailFixture implements Queueable, Finalizer { public static String result; public static String requestId; public static Exception exceptionValue; public void execute(QueueableContext context) { System.attachFinalizer(this); } public void execute(FinalizerContext context) { result = context.getResult().name(); requestId = context.getRequestId(); exceptionValue = context.getException(); } }

@IsTest private class FinalizerContextTailTest { @IsTest static void attachedContextRunsAfterQueueable() { Test.startTest(); System.enqueueJob(new FinalizerContextTailFixture()); Test.stopTest(); System.assertEquals('SUCCESS', FinalizerContextTailFixture.result); System.assertNotEquals(null, FinalizerContextTailFixture.requestId); System.assertEquals(null, FinalizerContextTailFixture.exceptionValue); } }
